# PR #155 correctness review

## A. Verdict

**PASS-WITH-NOTES** at `08f74822302742c63614f87479f1158918718161`.

No new correctness repair requested. The endpoint handoff retains fresh process-start validation and existing discovery/consent behavior. Live deployment evidence remains owed.

## B. Scope

Full plan-218 review against merged main `cee0113`: process observation, transport handoff, daemon injection/call sites, regressions, retired launch guard and docs. The detached worktree is clean and pinned. GitHub and `git ls-remote` agree on this head; PR is CLEAN with all six visible checks successful.

No local builds/tests, mutation checks, live socket probes or fleet measurements were run.

## C. AC1: one observed instant, no UDS ps fallback

The daemon injects `pij_harnesses::proc::observed_start` at the existing composition root. It samples `kernel_start(pid)` once and packs that same epoch-second value as local and UTC. The transport takes only the core `ObservedStart` type and observer closure; no dependency/architecture edge is added.

Exact-PID discovery compares the descriptor's local identity and Claude's UTC record against that one observation. Pane discovery retains the existing record/token rules. `None` or a mismatching start cannot authorize an endpoint; there is no UDS fallback to ps.

CI executed `one_in_process_reading_answers_both_comparisons_and_launches_nothing`, including the positive single-observation count, changed UTC and changed local controls, and unchanged launch counter. Real Linux reader parity against ps in local/UTC, other timezones and a reaped PID also executed. The daemon review regression uses the real observer with a ps-written UTC record.

## D. AC2: one-shot, scoped and bounded handoff

`Resolved::is_for` requires the same seat id, msg_id, process identity and pane. `remember` holds one mutex while pruning expired/matching entries, evicting at the 64-entry cap and adding the result. Clones share that bounded store. A failed discovery clears the matching prior probe; no timer or sweep is added.

`resolve` removes the matching entry before use, checks the five-second age and freshly rereads its PID's UTC start. A changed or unreadable start rejects the cached endpoint and falls through to existing discovery. A miss, expiry, eviction or spent entry likewise discovers afresh. It is not a lifetime PID cache.

Both can-deliver and deliver retain the Claude/command/inbound-consent gates. No endpoint from another message, process binding or pane matches the handoff.

CI executed:

- `deliver_uses_the_endpoint_its_probe_resolved`: removes record/key files after probing, still sends once with two observer calls, then refuses cache reuse.
- `a_peer_that_died_after_its_probe_is_not_written_to`: disables the observer while the witness listener remains open and verifies no connection. This distinguishes the re-read brake from socket-connect failure.
- `a_probe_serves_only_its_own_message` and retained recycled/stale-binding discovery regressions.
- `a_socket_drain_probes_once_then_delivers` and the extended FYI-carrier admission/direct-send call-count case.

The cap, expiry and full key comparisons were source-reviewed rather than separately mutation-tested here. Tapir's reported dropped-re-read and forced-rediscovery mutations align with the two distinguishing tests; they were not rerun by this reviewer.

## E. AC3: retired launch and cost boundaries

`spawn_sites::retired_launches_stay_retired` executed. It bans the retired site across production sources and `Command::new(` in production uds.rs, with a discovery-line positive/vacuity guard. The transport contains no production command runner.

For healthy exact-PID delivery, one discovery plus one handoff re-read means two observer calls; a carrier adds its admission discovery for three. Fallback discovery can inspect additional candidate records as before. These are observer counts: macOS samples one kernel record per call; Linux reads status/stat/boot procfs inputs.

The former 4/6 ps launches are removed from this production path. This does not claim the old live daemon already stopped launching them. Ocelot owns the matching-PID, comparable-traffic before/after measurement after deployment.

## F. AC4 and states

API documentation, ADR 0001's follow-up note and D-218-1 describe the shipped source change. `Delivers: none` and no migration are correct. Plan/pressure/phase remain unchecked/draft, rather than falsely closing the deployment reading.

## G. Exact-head CI and notes

[Run 42376556663](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42376556663) succeeded at this full head. Downloaded `junit-linux` contains 2,083 cases, zero failures/errors/skips, including the named handoff, brake, real-reader and retired-site cases.

**N001: platform proof ceiling.** CI exercises Linux and injected observers, not the macOS `proc_pidinfo` branch. Tapir reports merged-head macOS all-targets clippy clean; that is author evidence, not reviewer execution or macOS runtime parity proof.

**N002: identity precision and deployment scope.** The change preserves the existing whole-second, packed wall-time process-identity contract; it does not strengthen it to subsecond incarnation proof. The live AC3 reading remains owed, and the existing opt-in live-wire witness still uses its own ps observer rather than proving production launch removal.

## H. Handover

Source correctness is ready at this head. Retain independent security/performance verdicts and collect the after-deploy matched-process/traffic reading before whole-plan completion. No additional local test run is requested from this review seat.
